lines: Never look back at the dog on the coast road.
In East Anglia, they call it Black Shuck.
A hound as big as a calf, with one eye burning red.
On a stormy Sunday in 1577, it burst through the doors of Bungay church.
Lightning cracked. Two worshippers fell dead where they knelt.
Then it ran twelve miles to Blythburgh, and struck again.
The scorch marks are still on the church door. You can touch them.
Fishermen say if you hear paws behind you at night, keep walking.
Because those who see Black Shuck... rarely live out the year.
Have you ever heard footsteps that weren't there?
title: The Demon Dog That Left Claw Marks On A Church Door 😨 #shorts
description:
In 1577, a giant black hound burst into Bungay church during a storm. The scorch marks are still there today. This is the legend of Black Shuck.
